notes: Read 2026-11-14 from the GGUF headers only, by HTTP range reads of the commit resolve URLs, after checking x-repo-commit and x-linked-etag (SHA-256) against the pin. Shard 1 holds metadata only (0 tensors), so its header is the whole 10,946,618-byte file.
ne is ggml order: ne[0] is the contiguous (input) dimension. Expert tensors are [in, out, 512]; one expert is a contiguous byte range of nbytes/512.
offset is relative to the shard's data section (data_start, alignment 32); abs_offset = data_start + offset. Every shard's last tensor ends exactly at the file size.
Type ids and block sizes are from llama.cpp v1.0.0 (commit b1b770d90d94cad9e9ea5b993bdbc383a522fb28): ggml/include/ggml.h, ggml/src/ggml-common.h.
